mapper.select: SELECT CAST(setting_value AS SIGNED) FROM app_setting WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_setting (setting_key, setting_value) VALUES (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value = VALUES(setting_value), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userStatus = #{userStatus}
SELECT u.* FROM user u WHERE u.isDelete = 0 AND u.userStatus = #{userStatus} ORDER BY u.createTime ASC, u.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET totalScore = totalScore + #{totalScore}, winRate = CASE WHEN (wins + #{wins} + losses + #{losses}) = 0 THEN 0.0000 ELSE ROUND((wins + #{wins}) / (wins + #{wins} + losses + #{losses}), 4) END, wins = wins + #{wins}, losses = losses + #{losses} WHERE id = #{userId} AND isDelete = 0
